newsitem.title: USA: Silicon says judge denies Atmel's motions.
newsitem.headline: Silicon says judge denies Atmel's motions.

text.p: Silicon Storage Technology Inc said that a U.S. District Court judge has denied Atmel Corp 's motions for summary judgment in a lawsuit Atmel filed against Silicon in January 1996.
An Atmel spokesman was not available for comment.
Atmel sued Silicon claiming its flash memory components infringed on five Atmel patents, a news release issued by Silicon said.
In October 1996, Atmel filed motions for summary judgment under two of its patents, the "903" and the "811," claiming that as a matter of law, Atmel was entitled to judgment, the news release said.
On June 25, 1997, a judge denied both of Atmel's motions, the statement said.
The case is scheduled for trial November 24, 1997, the statement said.
